name: va-italy-remuneration-and-financial-assets
description: Vatican City and Holy See cross-border tax reference distinguishing qualifying remuneration under the Lateran Treaty from financial assets held by Italian tax residents at Vatican financial institutions. Covers eligibility for the 2015 convention's fiscal-representative mechanism, financial-income rate selection, conditional monitoring relief, central-entity exclusions and the separation of historic regularization from ongoing compliance. Includes evidence-led examples rather than a general claim of tax-free Vatican income. This source-cited draft does not determine personal residence, all employer statuses, pension classification, social contributions or current Italian asset-specific tax rates and requires independent review before application.
